nodes.title: Branch: 0.0 step 4 says `sortmycover-build`; this cloud session pushes to `claude/relaxed-edison-0hcidb`. Seeded on the session branch.
Replacement cap: 0.1 says per cycle (Bronze 4); 4.6 workflow list item 11 (No-show) says "cap 3/week per broker"; 3.5 says "up to X/week". 0.1 wins — confirm and fix the text.
Grace: 0.1 says no grace; 4.13 agreement text says "pause for non-payment (7-day grace)". 0.1 wins — contracts-drafter to drop it.
Phase 6 exit says margin ≥ 50%; 3.5 models ~43% at R200 CPL. Which target?
W33 judge should be a "separate agent file" (4.15) but the roster is 23 files. Add a 24th file?
4C.5 says unattended runs are "not GitHub Actions" and also "from a Makefile/GitHub Actions workflow". Pick one (recommend Makefile on the n8n host).
6.6 says "All 25 workflows"; 0.1 says W01–W35 (35).
4.3 production path still uses Google Flow renders; 0.1 says code-rendered first, Flow only as week-3 experiment. 0.1 wins.
Data store: master prompt targets self-hosted Postgres on the VPS; the existing CRM already runs on Supabase. platform-architect to resolve in the gap map (0.2 says reuse).
Repo .gitignore ignores *.json and *.txt globally — exception added for build/tasks.json; agents writing JSON/TXT deliverables need explicit exceptions.
Live schema drift: 12 tables referenced but undefined in repo; types.ts stale; appointments defined twice. Need a read-only schema dump of the live Supabase project before the first migration.
Hosting: CRM (incl. the public LV site pages) deploys to Vercel; prompt 6.7 says Hostinger + app.leadvelocity.co.za static. Keep Vercel for the CRM app? Confirm the live LV site is this repo.
Email transport: code sends via Resend; prompt 6.7 says Graph Mail.Send from howzit@. SortMyCover mail via Graph (bounce detection, audit trail); legacy stays on Resend; magic-link SMTP choice.

Two products, one CRM: legacy B2B tiers (Pilot/Bronze/Silver/Gold R6k–R16.5k, "guaranteed" wording, Ayanda cold calls) vs SortMyCover ladder. Separate by brand_id + SMC_* tier codes; withdraw B2B tiers from site (W25)? NCC cleanse to cover legacy cold-call leads? Money decision. compliance-qa recommends YES to cleansing legacy cold-call leads (penalty up to R1m / 10% turnover). The live Promotions page says "10% of broker commission (on placed business)" — the Raspberry Academy pattern (2.1.1) — plus "guaranteed" ×4 and sum-insured figures; creative-strategist recommends it comes down in W25 whatever else is decided.

Pre-existing security/POPIA defects in the live CRM (public PII read/write, USING(true) RLS, public bucket, unauthenticated service-role functions, browser-exposed Gemini key, passwords in tracked scripts). Approve migration 1 = security fixes + rotate + untrack scripts. Changes live product behaviour. NEW S10 (found while drafting migration 01): two live policies let ANY signed-in broker read every lead and every message - broker #2 is unsafe until migration 01 is applied.
Name collisions: put 6.8b/4.15 tables (proposals, notifications, pulses, signals, quality_grades, costs) in a Postgres schema `ops`. Default: yes.

POPIA processor list: add Supabase, Vercel, Twilio, Resend (+ Hostinger, ElevenLabs if voice fallback on) with regions to the privacy notice and processing register. Default: yes, regions read from each dashboard.

Contract mechanics drafted by default, need a money/legal yes: (a) dispute outcome after 48 h = LV decides within 2 business days with reasons; (b) "uncontactable" = verified lead who then goes silent through the full W08 sequence → replaceable within cap; (c) cycle start = day routing goes live after payment clears; (d) term sheet carries R16,500 typed — exclude signed docs from the W25 hard-coded-price check or generate from pricing; (e) refund within 10 business days when not renewing. Compliance-qa view: (b) as drafted quietly makes "booked" the unit sold — limit "uncontactable" to messages undelivered after verification or the broker marking unreachable on the booked call; and amend 3.3 so a lead who attends the call counts as verified even without a WhatsApp reply.
